source_evidence.text: I direct a university laboratory studying battery recycling.
A large manufacturer is offering three years of funding—enough for four researchers and equipment we could not otherwise afford.
The proposed work on recovering material from damaged cells is not a fake corporate side project.
It is good science and very close to what we already want to do.
I am not looking for a purity test.

I am trying to understand which forms of influence would make the science less trustworthy, which are ordinary coordination, and which might change the laboratory slowly enough that no single paper ever looks compromised.
